title: ContextPacket
description: The per-invocation view derived from the canonical_transcript and passed to a provider_adapter for a single agent invocation (§2.4, §4.3, blocker #3). NOT persisted as a top-level artifact: a context_packet is ephemeral, derivable from the canonical_transcript on demand. This schema exists so adapters and test harnesses (e.g. FakeProvider in §9) can serialize a packet for reproducibility tests. A consumer that has the canonical_transcript plus the derivation policy MUST be able to reproduce a packet (round-trip obligation).

problem_statement.description: The session's original problem_statement message content (§4.3 item a). Required in every packet.

persona.description: The invoked agent's own persona material (§4.3 item c). For a domain_persona, includes `domain_scope`/`forbidden_domains`/`must_delegate`.

panel_disclosure.description: Active_deliberation_panel disclosure (§4.3 item d, Pass 1 row #77). For each panel member, identifier + role/specialty summary. For the coordinator_agent's packet, lists every panel member; for a panel agent's packet, lists its peers.

most_recent_verdict.description: The most recent verdict if one exists (§4.3 item e). Absent in round 1. The verdict's `focus` SHOULD be highlighted as the round's directive.

current_round_messages.description: All messages produced in the current round so far, in `turn_index` ascending order (§4.3 item f). Covers every prior primary_turn, every drained branch turn, and every in-line branch turn dispatched earlier in this round. Required minimum for conversational deliberation.

branch_origin.description: Required when the invoked agent is a branch_turn agent (§4.3 item g). Carries the originating direct_request and the parent primary_turn message so the branch agent can answer in context.

deferred_queue_summary.description: For the coordinator_agent's packet, a summary of the deferred_request queue (target, originator, type — NOT full content) so the Coordinator can frame its verdict.focus (§4.6). Absent otherwise.

cumulative_disagreements.description: For the synthesis packet (§4.8): the cumulative resolved/unresolved disagreement record across the session. Absent in non-synthesis packets.

compression_note.description: Optional human-readable note documenting any compression, filtering, or windowing applied beyond the §4.3 minimum. Diagnostic only.
